subject: E-3122: token rejected on Linux
body:
Hi, I'm using MeshMail 2.8.4 on Ubuntu 24.04. Starting the weekend, the moment I open the app a
dialog reads 'E-3122: authentication token rejected'.

It only happens on the office network; on my phone's hotspot it works. A new corporate proxy went
live for the whole staff this month.

Before writing in I tried closing every other program; same error afterwards.

Regards, Daniel Ortega, Pinewood Legal
